verses.1: On the seventh day of the one hundred and onest day of the month, God’s word was given to the prophet Haggai.
verses.2: Say to Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, of Judah; and to Jehosua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and to the rest of the people, say this:
verses.3: Who among you remains who has seen this house in its original glory? What do you see it to be now, after all that has happened to it? It’s like a ruin in your eyes.
verses.4: And now, let Zerubbabel be strengthened. Let Jehovah’s word be made true. Let Yehoshua, son of Jehoshafat, the high priest, be strengthened. Let all the people of the earth be strengthened. Let Jehovah’s word be fulfilled. Let it happen as I say. Let Jehovah’s army be strong.
verses.5: What I have commanded you when you left Egypt, let them keep in mind. My spirit remains among you; do not be afraid.
verses.6: For as Jehovah, the Lord, said, “There is still one more thing left.” And I will stink the heavens, the earth, the sea, and the abyss.
verses.7: And I have caused all the nations to tremble. The nations came together in one place, and I filled this house with glory. As the Lord, the Almighty, said.
verses.8: To me, the money and the gold belong to me, says Jehovah, the army of heaven.
verses.9: May this house become great in honor. This is the second house from the first one. “May there be peace in this place,” says Jehovah, the God of armies.
verses.10: On the forty-second day of the seventh month, in the year of Darius’ reign, God spoke to the prophet Haggai with these words:
verses.11: So said Jehovah, the God of hosts: “Ask the priests for counsel.”
verses.12: And he shall take the sacred vessel with him, and touch it with his hand. He shall then touch the altar, the sacrificial offering, and all the sacred food. The priests would then say, “Do not do this.”
verses.13: And Haggai said, “If a person becomes dirty in all these ways, then he should be cleansed.” The priests replied, “Yes, he should be cleansed.”
verses.14: And Haggai said, “Thus shall this people and this nation be before Me. May the LORD speak thus regarding all their actions. And whatever impure things they offer there, it will be rejected.”
verses.15: And now, let us remember this from today onward. Let us remember that before the day comes when stones will be replaced by stones in the house of Jehovah.
verses.16: When they arrived at the city of forty, twenty of them went to the place where the fifty pomegranates were kept. And there were still twenty left.
verses.17: I have recorded all your deeds in Shedonfon and Yerakon, as well as in Barad. There is no one else who can know about your actions. May Jehovah not let you go away from me.
verses.18: Remember this day, and also remember the day after that, which was the forty-fourth day from the day when the kingdom of Jehovah was established. Remember these days in your hearts.
verses.19: The seeds that were sown in the wilderness, as well as the grapes, figs, and other plants, have not yet borne fruit from this day onward. Amen.
verses.20: And it happened that the word of Jehovah was spoken to Haggai on the 24th day of the month.
verses.21: Say to Zerubavel, son of Judah: “I will make the heavens and the earth stink.”
verses.22: And I became like a throne for kings; I was stronger than all the kings of the nations. I became a chariot, and horses and riders came down from it. One man rode on his horse, while another rode on his brother’s horse.
verses.23: On that day, say to the armies of Jehovah: “I will take Zerubbabel, son of Shealtiel, as my servant. Say to the armies of Jehovah: ‘You shall be like oxen, for in you I have chosen.’” Say to the armies of Jehovah, “May it be so!”
